name: Tianwen-2
about: Tianwen-2 (2025-114A, CASC), launched 2025 May 28. Its phases from GCAT: HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was
GCAT gives no heliocentric orbit for this phase
